claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a red bicycle but does not show readable brand/model markings or confirm it is a folding model.
No structural inspection (frame flex/cracks) shown; only general used-condition scuffing/dirt noted.
Tire tread/condition, punctures, and whether brakes work are not shown; only light dirt/scuffing and a front wheel guard/headlight are mentioned.
No clear view of shifters, derailleur/cassette, or drivetrain condition in the witness observations.
No purchase date, receipt, or odometer/usage evidence shown.

claims.claim: Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original
claims.evidence: Witness notes light dirt/scuffing and slight wear on the front fork area; rust is not confirmed either way, but 'no rust' is not supported by the report.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, punctured, or not holding air (affects safety and immediate cost).
risks.proof: Short video clip showing each tire close-up (tread), checking for punctures/sidewall cracks, and a quick pump/pressure test or ride test with no air loss.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown tire condition (assume possible tire replacement/repairs needed).

risks.risk: Brakes may not be functional or may need adjustment/replacement (affects stopping safety).
risks.proof: Clip of a brake test: squeeze both brakes while stationary and then a slow ride showing strong stopping; show brake pads/lining condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not guaranteed working (assume adjustment/pad replacement may be required).

risks.risk: Gears/shifting may be faulty or misadjusted (affects usability).
risks.proof: Video showing shifting through all gears while pedaling, with clear view of shifters and rear derailleur/chain behavior (no skipping).
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain/gear condition unknown (assume possible tune-up or parts replacement).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/bearings may be worn causing wobble or poor tracking (affects ride safety and tire wear).
risks.proof: Clip showing wheels spun in place (side view) for wobble and a straight-line test; also show fork/frame alignment visually.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible bearing/alignment issue (assume service may be needed).

risks.risk: Folding mechanism (if it is a folding model) may be loose or damaged (affects stability).
risks.proof: Photos/video of the folding joints locked/unlocked, showing play-free lock engagement and a shake test when locked.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified folding condition (assume worst-case: folding parts may need tightening/repair).

risks.risk: Headlight/wiring may be non-functional or incomplete (affects included accessories value).
risks.proof: Clip showing the headlight turning on/off with power source visible (battery/dynamo) and confirming wiring is intact.
risks.if_unproven: Price as accessories not guaranteed functional/included.

risks.risk: Hidden frame damage/cracks or heavy rust not visible in the single photo angle (affects structural safety).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame welds, joints, and any stress points (especially around folding hinges if present), plus underside inspection; include a bright-light crack check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structural condition unknown beyond light scuffing (assume possible need for inspection/repair).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the full bike including shifters, rear derailleur/gear cluster, and any brake types (front and rear).
Video of a full brake test (stationary squeeze + slow ride stop) and close-up of brake pads/lining.
Video of shifting through all gears while pedaling (no skipping, smooth engagement).
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls, plus a quick ride test showing no air loss.
Video showing wheels spun for wobble and a straight-line tracking test.
If it is folding: photos/video of the folding hinge/lock mechanism fully engaged and a shake test.
Photos showing any brand/model markings clearly (frame/seat tube/sticker) and a receipt or proof of purchase date.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used red bicycle with some visible wear and a headlight, but key items that determine price (tire/brake/gear working condition and exact brand/model/folding status) are not verifiable from the report. Request the specific clips/photos to price safely.
